program.name: Combo Builder
program.subject: Boxing
program.blurb: Bouts that grow from two punches to six, then defence and counters.
program.about: Long boxing sessions built around combinations. One day the bouts climb from jab-cross to four, five and six punches; the other drills slips, rolls and pulls with the counter that follows, then straight sets of push-ups and squats. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels bring longer combinations and harder moves.
program.split: Two-punch to six-punch bouts / defence & counter bouts
